paper_verdict.estimator_family: Panel FE/RE production function on first-differenced logs (random effects preferred), with 2SLS and AR(1) robustness; classic panel regression, not a pure IV design
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Coefficient is an output elasticity of IT hardware capital stock from a Cobb-Douglas model with labour and non-IT capital held fixed, estimated on first-differenced logs (growth-on-growth), so not comparable with level or penetration-based ICT estimates. Estimates 1-11 reuse the same 45-country panel (all/developing/developed x FE/RE/2SLS/AR(1)), so they are not independent; the full sample overlaps the two subsamples. Estimates 12-14 are interaction coefficients on mean-centred variables, not elasticities, and should not be pooled with main effects. Table 6 immigration N (283/51) is inconsistent with Table 4. 'Developing' group is IMF classification, upper-income only per authors; 'developed' includes Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore. Outcome is GDP level (PPP), not TFP or labour productivity.
